in_marathi.name: Hitaanshi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sunlight or radiance
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hitaanshi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Hitaanshi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'hita' which means 'welfare, happiness' and 'ansh' which means 'ray, sunlight, radiance'. The name Hitaanshi is believed to signify the one who radiates happiness and brings joy and prosperity to the lives of others.
